name: STX Engine Co.,Ltd.
summary: Based in Changwon, South Korea, STX Engine Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of UAMCO., Ltd. The company, established in 1976 and formerly known as STX Corporation until its name change in April 2004, is a South Korean manufacturer. It specializes in the production and distribution of various diesel engines for marine applications and power generators. Furthermore, STX Engine provides specialized land and sea engines, along with their related components, and supplies telecommunications equipment for the defense sector.
